'''Dulios''' was a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he was based in [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], from where he sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to perform a number of tasks.

==Behind the scenes==
Dulios appeared as a non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
